item.title: Life and death at the end of Genesis
item.description: Jacob’s life and heritage are celebrated in the final section of Genesis.

item.title: A Christian approach to taxation
item.description: Although Christians should accept that governments have a right to raise taxes and Christians have an obligation to pay them, this does not mean that Christians should approve of all forms of taxation that governments may decide to impose.

item.title: Christians Against Poverty launch post-Christmas debt campaign
item.description: Christmas is over and it's now back to reality for many families.

item.title: Calls for protection of Colombian religious leaders after another pastor is murdered
item.description: José Otoniel Ortega is not the first Colombian pastor to be murdered by unknown gunmen.

item.title: Philip Yancey steps down from ministry after revealing long-term affair
item.description: Renowned Christian author Philip Yancey has announced that he will withdraw from public ministry, following the revelation of a long-term extramarital affair.

item.title: Donnie McClurkin denies rape claims from former parishioner
item.description: Popular gospel singer and pastor Donnie McClurkin said recent claims of rape and sexual assault from a man who served as a personal assistant at his church are “contrived and untrue." Believing he “will be vindicated," he asked for prayers for his accuser.

item.title: Pre-Nicene Christian art found in Turkey
item.description: The mural predates the Council of Nicaea in 325 AD.

item.title: 42 Christian and Muslim men executed by bandits in Nigeria, women and children abducted
item.description: Nigeria greeted the New Year with yet more violence by militants, with 50 people killed in a number of attacks that took place between 28 December and 3 January in the Middle Belt region.

item.title: Churches urged to support alcohol-free January as millions sign up nationwide
item.description: Churches across the UK are being encouraged to actively support Dry January this New Year, as millions of people commit to a month without alcohol.

item.title: The secret to true and lasting change
item.description: True and lasting change is possible - though perhaps not in the way we’ve been taught to pursue it.
